question: Do frozen features predict patch-mean FeO and TiO2, and does the fusion of in-domain and cross-domain features beat each alone on a regression task?

labels.source: published aligned LPGRS FeO and TiO2 rasters at revision 53099efd, sampled only over the fixed Train/Val tiles
labels.computation: mean of finite pixels inside each 256x256 window; every selected tile was fully finite
labels.target_scaling: z-score using Train means and standard deviations; metrics reported on the original scale

baselines: predict the Train mean for each target
linear regression on the Moonstone features only
acceptance: All 6,290 selected tiles have fully finite LPGRS windows
Labels are computed only for Train/Val tiles
No Test ID is read or scored
claims_not_permitted: Test performance or operational geochemistry claims
Causal or regional interpretation of correlations
